text.offer: Pure disciple of our Lady of the Silver Light, will you give of yourself so that your Goddess may be stronger? Worship with me, then. Together, we will draw upon our own life essence to birth a symbol of our Lady's purity. Incant these words with me: By the light of a bright sun, we beseech thee, Shal'ille, rebirth us.
text.complete: Praise Shal'ille! Go now, carry forth into the world this symbol of our Lady's purity of spirit! Placed at one of the Shrines around the world, it will dedicate the Shrine to Shal'ille.
